ms.promise:
This this first milestone we'll deliver six scripts that will be used as voiceover and a descriptive visual brief which will be used to create motion graphic explainer videos. 
These scripts will allow us to get started on the motion graphic videos. These motion graphic videos will make Cardano easy for new users. These scripts will eventually live inside Atrium. We currently have 24 videos already made, and live. We'll add these videos in on a future milestone.
ms.criteria:
Acceptance Criteria:
・Must submit six scripts that are educational and informative.
・These scripts must be written in a way that allows them to be used as a voiceover, and created into a motion graphic explainer video.
